variants.label: B1 — 経路上の相手への直進
variants.prompt: Single square game skill icon, 1024x1024, flat 2D vector graphic. Near-black charcoal background. A large anonymous ivory human silhouette on the left side, facing right. A straight horizontal dashed line extends from the figure toward the right edge. A second smaller anonymous ivory human silhouette stands on the path near the right side. At the point where the path meets the second figure, a sparse cyan ring impact glyph. A faint cool grey afterimage ghost of the first figure lingers at the origin. Bold simple shapes, high contrast, readable at 32-64 pixels. No text, no logos, no border, no gore, no weapons.
variants.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, frame, ornate scenery, gore, blood, weapons, multiple panels, grid, sheet, 3D render, photorealistic, gradient, complex details, extra limbs, faces, clothing details, action pose, dynamic pose
variants.notes: Draft source facts: SHADEは探索系ランク2の設計案。ステルス状態で直線上を瞬間移動し、経路上の相手へ中ダメージ・中Stun。不可視持続時間と全Anomaly Entityへの検知回避は未確定。System ID未定。Visual hypothesis: 左に大きな象牙色匿名人型シルエット（瞬間移動する者）、右に経路上の相手シルエット。破線で直線経路を示し、交点にシアンのリング型衝撃グリフト。原点に残像。色・残像・衝撃表現は仮案であり、仕様・攻撃方式を確定しない。
